description:
The PostJoy S9 Fat Tire Electric Bike is made for riders who want power, range, and all-terrain stability in one bold electric bike. With a 2500W peak motor, 48V 20Ah battery, 28+ MPH top speed, and up to 55 miles of range, the S9 is built for long-distance rides, weekend adventures, and confident daily commuting.

The PostJoy S9 is designed for riders who want a powerful fat tire eBike with long-range capability and modern smart features. It delivers the performance needed for city streets, gravel roads, beach paths, snow, and light off-road terrain.
Powered by a 2500W peak motor, the S9 offers fast acceleration and strong riding support. Its 48V 20Ah battery provides up to 55 miles of max range, giving riders the freedom to explore farther on a single charge.
The 20" x 4.0" fat tires improve traction and stability across changing terrain, while the front suspension fork helps smooth out bumps for a more controlled ride. With NFC Smart Unlock, precision disc brakes, IPX6 water resistance, and a 28+MPH top speed, the S9 is a high-performance fat tire eBike built for adventure and everyday freedom.
